database.target: Dedicated tmpfs fraud-provider-phase2-db on fraud-provider-phase2-test; isolated databases per test
database.down_behavior: Shared extensions retained; source index/generated projection/function reverted

architecture.scenario: Existing session BFF -> current authoring permissions -> canonical v2 config/audit -> decision evaluation -> durable execution -> authenticated exact-request/parent proof -> separate run authority -> real screening worker -> published PostgreSQL data -> results/case delivery/enrichment/review
architecture.scope: Manual sessions remain current-identity scoped. Scenario scopes bind active tenant/config, exact stored execution/request and its allowed dataset set across all five operations; no client tenant/owner field becomes authority.
architecture.enrichment: Signed investigator JWT plus current tenant/case/inbox/exact-match access; provider IO outside locks; current access rechecked before merging with latest review state
architecture.source_owner_reads: Decision authoring reads scoped screening publication metadata; screening validates core execution/config/decision parents. No cross-owner mutations introduced.
architecture.legacy: Named OpenSanctions v1 meaning preserved; no synthetic fallback; actual internal scenario test observed zero legacy HTTP calls
